messages.subject: Shared UI between clients
parts:
Hi,

after some words with Joe few days ago, here is a working demo of a shared UI between different clients (say browsers) :

ui.R
=====================
library(shiny)

shinyUI(pageWithSidebar(  
  headerPanel("Shared session"),
  sidebarPanel(),
  
  mainPanel(
    uiOutput("slider")
  )
))

server.R
=====================
value <<- reactiveValues(v=5)

shinyServer(function(input, output, session) {
    
    id = floor(1000*runif(1))
    
    observe({
        cat(id)
        cat(".\n")
        value$v <- input$slider
    })
    
    output$slider <- renderUI({
        cat(id)
        cat("x\n")
        if(is.numeric(value$v)) v=value$v else v=5
        return(sliderInput("slider",label="",min=0,max=10, value=v))
    })
    
})


...reactive programming is amazing !

Thank you a lot Joe !

Yann
